title: Water Propeller
description: This datapack boosts you at high speeds when you are in water
body:
WARNING: versions before release 1.21.11 will kill all your villagers.

this datapack will boost you while you are under water. it may also cause lag on weaker devices.

if you want to see how it works, just place a few repeathing command blocks with /effect clear @e[type=villager]

thanks! :D
